summary: Update input routing and XFS utilities with verified rollback archives; retain preexisting integration and configuration review items.
changes: Completed a full configured-repository upgrade: inputplumber 0.82.0-1.1 to 0.83.0-1.1 and xfsprogs 7.2.0-1.1 to 7.2.1-1.1. No packages were added or removed. Standard package hooks refreshed hardware data and system definitions. Recorded a private maintenance plan, before/after evidence, configuration backups and signed previous package archives; refreshed package databases and cache. No reboot or manual service activation was performed.
tests: ChatGPT login status recognized before and after. Package database checks passed before and after. Both previous package archives passed checksum/signature checks; both staged new packages passed trusted signature checks and had no install scriptlets. Upgrade exited successfully. Post-upgrade file and integrity checks passed for both updated packages. Command version checks reported inputplumber 0.83.0 and XFS utilities 7.2.1. The isolated update query and synchronized system database showed no remaining updates. Protected configuration fingerprints, repository and signature policy, keyboard, kernel, package service states and systemd jobs were preserved. No new failed units appeared. Timer remains enabled at a 30-minute interval and the maintenance service retains an unlimited local start duration. A preexisting journal directory group warning remains; the broader integrity check therefore still reports a warning. Runtime gaming, filesystem repair and performance benchmarks were not executed.
rollback: Verified previous signed package archives were retained before the upgrade. If regression is confirmed, review dependencies and reinstall only the two previous package versions using the package manager; restore only captured configuration files if affected. No rollback was needed or executed. Do not perform a global restore, reboot or job resumption automatically.
problem: The existing local compatibility service remains failed because prior evidence did not satisfy its acceptance gates; the currently installed bundled CLI is newer than the last checked identity. Installed desktop and permissions also differ from the recorded requested baseline. These items predate this update. An initial attempt to download an older rollback package could not obtain detached signature metadata from mirrors.
solution: Completed the authorized package update after preserving rollback. Recovered the old package signature from existing package metadata, verified its checksum and trusted signature, and retained the verified archive. Preserved compatibility failure evidence and all existing jobs; did not reset the service, promote its baseline, migrate desktops or change permissions. Recorded local proposals for the unresolved items.
reproduction: For the package maintenance result, compare installed versions and run package database, package integrity and pending-update checks. For the preexisting integration state, inspect service status and compare its saved accepted identity with the installed bundled CLI. Full compatibility acceptance still requires the native evidence capabilities specified by that local integration.
